name: CROPS-1-half-x-unhalved
note: The 85 m field from -42.5 again: half a metre off the component's grid along x.

name: CROPS-2-half-z-unhalved
old: hz = Math.trunc(spec.rangeZ / 2); // `-rangeX / 2` over C#'s int: -42 for 85
new: hz = spec.rangeZ / 2; // `-rangeX / 2` over C#'s int: -42 for 85

name: CROPS-3-no-refusal
old: if (solid && solid(px, y, pz, CROP_OVERLAP_RADIUS)) continue; // IsOverlapping: the plant is not sown
note: Plants grow through every wall, tower and stand-in again.

name: CROPS-5-asked-off-the-foot
old: if (solid && solid(px, y, pz, CROP_OVERLAP_RADIUS)) continue; // IsOverlapping: the plant is not sown
new: if (solid && solid(px, y + 1, pz, CROP_OVERLAP_RADIUS)) continue; // IsOverlapping: the plant is not sown
note: The sphere asked a metre over the plant's foot, not at it.

name: CROPS-6-taken-in-turn
old: out.push({ archive, record: records[Math.floor(rnd() * records.length)], x: px, y, z: pz }); // GetRandomRecord
new: out.push({ archive, record: records[out.length % records.length], x: px, y, z: pz }); // GetRandomRecord
note: The two records in turn again, not GetRandomRecord's pick.

name: CROPS-7-desert2-the-first-deserts
old: if (climateIndex === CLIMATES.Desert2) return [CROP_ARCHIVE, [20]]; // FIELD BUGS 2026-10-04d CROPS: Desert2's own
new: if (climateIndex === CLIMATES.Desert2) return [CROP_ARCHIVE, [2]]; // FIELD BUGS 2026-10-04d CROPS: Desert2's own
note: The second desert sows the first's plant.

name: CROPS-8-reach-never
note: No face is ever within reach: the block's solids refuse nothing.

name: CROPS-9-cull-the-low-side
old: if (x < box[0] - r || x > box[3] + r || y < box[1] - r || y > box[4] + r || z < box[2] - r || z > box[5] + r)
new: if (x < box[0] + r || x > box[3] + r || y < box[1] - r || y > box[4] + r || z < box[2] - r || z > box[5] + r)
note: A model's box culled a metre too far in on its low x side: the metre outside its west face is never asked.

name: CROPS-10-corner-region
old: if (d1 <= 0 && d2 <= 0) return at(ax, ay, az);
new: if (d1 <= 0 && d2 <= 0) return at(bx, by, bz);
note: A point off a triangle's first corner measured to its second.

name: CROPS-11-edge-region
old: return at(ax + v * abx, ay + v * aby, az + v * abz);
note: A point off an edge measured to the edge's end.

name: CROPS-12-the-turn-read
note: The batch's record turn moves its field: the turn read where the component never reads it.

name: CROPS-13-foot-on-the-record
note: The plants a tenth of a metre over the batch again.

name: CROPS-14-collector-drops-the-batch
note: The collector hands the field neither the climate nor the solids.

name: CROPS-15-world-host-no-solids
old: const flatOpts = { climateIndex: maps.getClimateIndex(px, py), solid: blockSolids(b.layout.models, (m) => (m.enhancedOnly && !isEnhanced() ? null : cpuModels.get(m.modelIdNum))) };
new: const flatOpts = { climateIndex: maps.getClimateIndex(px, py), solid: null };
note: The streamed world's fields grow through the block again.

name: CROPS-16-exterior-host-no-climate
old: const blockFlats = collectBlockFlats(b.dfBlock, natureArchive, { climateIndex: locClimateIndex, solid: fieldSolids })
new: const blockFlats = collectBlockFlats(b.dfBlock, natureArchive, { climateIndex: null, solid: fieldSolids })
note: The one-location exterior's fields cannot tell the second desert.
